<!-- Release: v0.26.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Add Compact, Normal and Large lists to the reversible pinch sequence.
- Share one Sort/View save scope, with matching secondary selectors and a content-fitted panel.
- Reuse browsing queries and selection geometry, crop scrolling scenes, and simplify shared shadow rendering.

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/176 - Shared Sort/View scope and selector panels.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/177 - List sizes and reversible pinch views.

Performance measurements and physical-device follow-up remain in https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/167.

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.26.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted. It updates the existing development app.
3. First use: open **More → Scan music**, choose **Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
